pricing.title: Clinic catalogue
pricing.subtitle: What the clinic prescribes and charges for: drugs with concentration and dosing, procedures, care and daily rates. Entered once, it flows into the prescription and the bill on its own.
pricing.priceWarning: A price change applies only to new prescriptions; bills already posted keep the value of their time.
pricing.form.name: Item
pricing.form.priceHint: In the clinic's currency, as it appears on the owner's bill (e.g. 18.00).
pricing.form.isDaily: This is a daily hospitalization rate
pricing.form.isDailyHint: The daily rate is charged on its own every day of the stay, without depending on anyone executing a task.
pricing.form.kennelAreaHint: The daily rate applies to kennels in this area (ICU, isolation, general).
pricing.form.isControlledHint: Warns at execution time and flags the item on the record and in the controlled-drug log.
pricing.form.isActiveHint: Deactivating removes the item from new prescriptions but keeps everything already charged.
pricing.footer: Nothing here changes a closed bill: the value is copied into the prescription when it is written, never looked up later.
pricing.emptyAll: No item in the price list.
pricing.emptyHint: With no price on file, a prescription posts nothing to the owner's bill.
pricing.emptyFilterHint: Clear the search and filters to see the whole list.
pricing.form.priceCurrencyHint: In {{currency}}, as it appears on the owner's bill (e.g. 18.00).
pricing.form.kennelAreaUnknown: No kennel uses this area today: until one does, this daily rate is never posted.
pricing.form.concentrationHint: This is what turns a dose into volume in the syringe: 0.54 mg of a 2 mg/ml presentation is 0.27 ml.
pricing.dosing.title: Dosing
pricing.dosing.lead: How much per kilo, by species. This is the rule the calculator uses when someone prescribes this item.
pricing.dosing.afterSave: Save the item first: dosing opens right after.
pricing.dosing.none: No dosing on file. Without it, whoever prescribes works the dose out in their head.
pricing.dosing.loadFailed: Could not read the dosing for this item.
pricing.dosing.needsConcentration: Without the concentration in mg/ml the calculation stops at mg and never becomes volume in the syringe.
pricing.dosing.confirmRemove: Remove this dosing rule? Prescriptions already written stay as they are.
pricing.dosing.unreviewed: Nobody reviewed this: it fills in no dose
pricing.dosing.speciesHint: A species rule beats the generic one. Dogs and cats metabolise differently.
pricing.dosing.contraindicatedHint: Prescribing stays possible, with a prominent warning. The licensed vet decides.
pricing.dosing.modePerKgHint: The dose is multiplied by the patient's weight.
pricing.dosing.modeFixedHint: The dose is for the whole animal and is not multiplied by weight. Multiplying a fixed dose IS the dosing error.
pricing.dosing.maxTotalHint: Optional. Above it the system warns and shows the capped value.
pricing.dosing.breedsHint: Comma separated. Breed becomes a warning, never arithmetic: the system warns and the vet decides.
pricing.dosing.breedWarningPlaceholder: MDR1 variant: reduce the dose or switch drug.
pricing.dosing.reviewHint: Without this review the rule fills in nothing on a prescription. It is recorded with your name and the date.
pricing.dosing.reviewNeedsVet: Only someone who can prescribe may say a dose was reviewed. You can enter the number; a vet reviews it later.
